book.name: Yohane
book.title: Malobhe gha Mbone ngita chighajhandikwe na Yohane

content: Nikodemo inyendele Yecho kilo
Bhahe, pakibha na kilongoche nkolongwa jhumo jwa Akayahude, mundo jwa likunde lya Mapwalichayo, liina lyake Nikodemo.

Lichiko limo uwiko Nikodemo ajhakunyendelela Yecho, ajhakunnobholela, “Mmola, tumanye kubhehe mwenga ndi Mmola jhutumitwe na Chapanga. Nhwalo abhii jhe mundo jhojhoha jwahotola kuhenga nginyililo yumuhenga mwenga anda Chapanga nakubhehe jhe pamonga.”
Yecho ajhakujhanguu, “Ninnobholela chakaka, abhii jhe mundo nahotola kujhingila mu Nahota nkolongwa gwa Chapanga anda abhelwike ndeka mala jhubhele.”
Nikodemo ajhakunkonya Yecho, “Bho, mundo nkolongwa ihoto bho kubhelukwa mala jhubhele? Chakaka iwechekana jhe mundo ajhingii mulutumbo lwa majhe na kubhelukwa kabhele!”
Yecho ajhakujhanguu, “Ninnobholela chakaka, abhii jhe mundo jwa kujhingii mu Nahota Nkologwa gwa Chapanga anda abatichwe kwa mache na Uhuke gwa Chapanga.”
Mundo jwabhelwike kwa yegha kuhumii kwa majhe na tate mundo, nambo chikibhelwike kwa Uhuke ndi kihuma kwa Uhuke gwa Chapanga.
Nkotoka kukangacha nhwalo ninnobholela nipala mmelukwe mala jhubhele.
Upepo upogha kupala kupoghela, mujhoha puupogha, nambo muumanye jhe kuhumii hilu kupoghela. Ndi chikipitila kwa kila mundo jwabhelwike kwa Uhuke gwa Chapanga.
Nikodemo ajhakunkonya, “Bho, ilebhe naihotola kupitila?”
Yecho ajhakunyanguu, “Mwenga mwa mmola nkolongwa jwa ku Ichilahele, na mwenga muhimanyite jhe ilebhe hengeno?”
Chakaka ninnobholela, twenga tulonge ilebhe itumanya na natilongela ilebhe ituhwene kwa miho ghito, nambo mangota mwamela mujheketela ndeka malobhe ghito.
Mukannyeketii ndeka puninnobholila ilebhe ya pannema pano, bhole nanyeketela jhe anda ninnobholile ilebhe ya kunane kwa Chapanga?
Abhii jhe mundo jwajhihwii kunane kwa Chapanga, nambo Mwana gwa Mundo jwahumite kunane kwa Chapanga.
Ngita Mucha panyinwila lijhoka lya chaba kwa luyato kunjenga kola, helahela Mwana gwa Mundo ipalwa ajhinwulilwa,
kila mundo jwannyeketela abhehe na ughome gwa machiko ghoha ghangapeta.
Kwa nhwalo Chapanga akapahile hake bhando bha pannema, ade ajhakummoha Mwana jwa kanjika, kila mundo jwanyeketela akotoka kuhobha, nambo abhaha na ughome gwa machiko ghoha ghangapeta.
Nhwalo Chapanga akantumite ndeka Mwana mundo pannema pano kwahadabula bhando, nambo nnema aughombole kwa kupete jwenio.
Mundo jhojhoha jwanyeketile Mwana bhihadabu ndeka, nambo mundo jhojhoha jwangannyeketela akihahadabwii njwe, nhwalo anyekite ndeka Mwana jwa kanjika jwa Chapanga.
Naha ndi chimpala kuhadabulwa, lumule luhikite pannema, nambo bhando bhipala lubhendo na kululeka lumule, nhwalo ghibhahenga mabhoho.
Kila mundo jwaitenda mabhoho aluchimwa lumule, na jwenio hukana kuhika palumule, nhwalo ijhoghopa mabhoho naghabhonekana mbegha.
Nambo mundo jhola jwaitenda gha chakaka ujhenda palumule, kupala ghala ghahenga ghabhonekena mbegha kwa kunyokanikiya Chapanga.
Yohane Mbatichajhe na Yecho
Pughajhomokila gheniya, Yecho na bhabholwa bhake bhajhakujhenda ade ku muche gwa ku Yudeya, ajhakubhehe kwenio ajhakutama nako, kwenio abaticha bhando.
Helahela Yohane akibha abaticha ku Ainoniya, pahina na ku Salemo, nhwalo peniya pakibha na mache twe. Bhando bhamahele bhanyendilila, na jwenio ajhakwabaticha.
Ghanga ghatendika Yohane pakibha atabhitwe mukipungo.
Bhahe, pajhakubhehe na mitaungano pakate jha bhabholwa bha Yohane na Akayahude mambu gha kukijhelebhula kwa kunyopa Chapanga.

Bhabholwa bheniya bhajhakunyendelela Yohane na kunnobholela, “Mmola, mundo jhola jhumukibha pamonga na mwenga kwiye jha ku Yolodane, na jhumutulobholila malobhe ghake, ngoheno jwenio abaticha na bhando bhinyendelela.”
Yohane ajhakwajhanguu, “Abhii jhe mundo jwahoto kupokela kilebhe changapelwa na Chapanga.
Mangota mabhene umanye puninnobholila, ‘Nenga na Kilichitu Nkomboche jhe, nambo ndei kutumwa kulongolela.’

Jwabhii na nnyina mwale mwikeghe ndi jwake nnyina mwale munalome. Nambo njeche jwa nnyina mwale ajhema pahina na kujhokanikiya, nhwangana pahijhoha lilobhe lya nnyina mwale munalome akilongela. Naha ndi chibhii kwa nenga ngoheno luhangano lwango pulukamilika.
Bhahe, jwenio Yecho ipala abhaha nkolongwa na nenga maha jwandina.”
Jhola jwabhoka kuhumii kunane kwa Chapanga

Jwenio jwahika kuhumii kunane kwa Chapanga ndi nkolongwa kuliku bhoha. Mundo jwa pannema pano apitii pannema na ulongela ilebhe ya pannema, nambo jwahika kuhumii kunane kwa Chapanga ndi jwalongocha ghoha.
Jwenio alongela ghala ghaghahwene na kughajhoha, nambo abhii jhe hilu mundo jhumo jwajheketela malobhe ghalongila.
Nambo mundo jhojhoha jwanyeketela malobhe ghake, chakaka ilangiya Chapanga ndi uchakaka.
Jhola jwatumitwe na Chapanga, ulonge malobhe gha Chapanga, nhwalo Chapanga untwelekeya lombilombi mundo jwenio Uhuke gwa Chapanga.
Tate impala Mwana mundo na akamwii ilebhe yoha mu mabhoko ghake.
Mundo jhojhoha jwanyeketela Mwana abhii na ughome gwa machiko ghoha ghangapeta, nambo mundo jhojhoha jwanga nnyeketela Mwana akwete jhe ughome, najhendelela kubhehe pahe jha luchwapulo lwa Chapanga.
